name: parallel-decomp-machine-hard-gate
title: Parallel-decomposition hard PLAN->DEV gate + contract reconcile (program Story 5, serial integration)
description: Story 5 (serial, last) of the parallel-decomposition gate program (spec §4.4 + §8 line 721): the two coordinated edits that turn the gate into a real PLAN->DEV hard block, plus reconciling the frozen contract. (1) Reconcile core/parallel-decomposition.ts to re-export the real computeWriteSet/globsOverlap/evaluateDecompositionGate impls (Story 0 froze them as NotImplemented skeletons). (2) Wire evaluateDecompositionGate into canStartDevGuard (machine.ts, the real decision oracle) as a FAIL-OPEN sub-check that enforces gateResult.block only under parallelGate.mode==='block'. (3) Mirror the block reason in getGuardFailureReason (the message), sharing one predicate. Consumes the merged Stories 0-4: types (B-59c7), computeWriteSet/globsOverlap (B-4033), evaluateDecompositionGate (B-986c), resolveAuditConfig().parallelGate (B-d2a8), safeReadScopeContract (B-fa7c). CRITICAL: the new sub-check is FAIL-OPEN (own try/catch, falls through to allow) — opposite of the surrounding fail-closed review guard — so a gate/config infra error never blocks PLAN->DEV (spec §4.8). New hermetic integration smoke; registered in lattice.config.json.
